claim_boundary.licensed_if_pass: Stage 24A can support token-level CAS sonar and bounded component-level causal localization claims, depending on which track passes.
claim_boundary.not_yet_claimed: Exact neuron-level or SAE-disentangled feature causality remains untested until a separate SAE/path-patching stage runs.
claim_boundary.product_relevance: Stage 24A strengthens CAS Harness evidence depth; it is not a blocker for Evidence Packet or Verification Stack productization.

sae_followup.trigger: Run if component attribution is distributed/polysemantic or if exact feature-level causal localization becomes the explicit research goal.

tracks.claim_if_null: Stage 7 readout remains valid, but token-level vocabulary signatures are not established.
tracks.claim_if_pass: CAS Harness maps bounded CAS readout directions to model-native token signatures.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim the model would necessarily generate the top sonar tokens.
Do not claim token signatures are neuron-level causal circuits.
Do not claim universal sonar transfer before cross-model runs.
method: Recover the locked Stage 7 Foundation probe raw-space class directions.
Project each Foundation class direction through Pythia-160M output embeddings.
Report top positive and negative tokens per Foundation, Drive, and Register.
Compare within-drive/same-register similarity against hard-partner and random controls.
Check involution/contrast pairs for token-signature opposition where applicable.
tracks.name: sonar_token_signatures
null_gate: Class signatures are no more stable than random directions.
Within-axis similarity does not beat hard-partner or random controls.
Top tokens are dominated by tokenizer artifacts or corpus leakage terms.
pass_gate: Top-token signatures are stable under bootstrap or split-resample controls.
Same-Drive or same-Register classes are more similar than hard-partner controls.
Random same-rank directions do not reproduce the observed class-specific structure.
tracks.question: Do Stage 7 Foundation probe directions induce class-specific vocabulary signatures through the model's unembedding/token space?
tracks.subject: cas_harness_pythia160m_foundation_subspace

tracks.claim_if_null: Component-level localization is not established; SAE/path-patching becomes the next research route.
tracks.claim_if_pass: CAS Harness can localize bounded CAS readout signal to transformer components with causal evidence.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact monosemantic neurons from component-level evidence.
Do not claim full generation control from readout-component disruption.
Do not claim SAE-level feature localization unless SAEs are trained and tested.
method: Hook attention-head outputs and MLP intermediate activations on the locked Stage 7 fixture.
Rank components by projection/alignment to the Stage 7 Foundation subspace.
Ablate top-ranked components and matched random controls.
Measure Foundation probe accuracy drop, per-class disruption, and specificity.
Cross-reference high-ranking components with sonar token signatures when available.
tracks.name: component_attribution_pilot
null_gate: Top-ranked components do not beat matched random controls.
Ablation damage is nonspecific or equivalent across classes.
Signal appears too distributed for component-level localization without SAE methods.
pass_gate: Top-ranked component ablation degrades Foundation readout more than matched random controls.
Disruption is class-specific rather than a global activation-damage artifact.
At least one component family clears a pre-registered effect floor.
tracks.question: Can CAS Harness localize Foundation readout signal from the residual subspace down to specific transformer components?
tracks.subject: pythia160m_attention_heads_and_mlp_intermediates
